text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh~♪ Standing right over theeeere~♪ Is 
our great supreme oveeeerlord~♪"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I came,♪ I saw,♪ I conquered!♪ Because 
none other than I am here~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And right here, go fortissimo! BAM, 
DA-DUM! DUM-LAAAAAN!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. As you can see, I'm 
rehearsing for the opera.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Starring me! Featuring Earth-kun on the 
acoustic guitar! It's an epic masterpiece 
bound to carve its name into history!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! I can see it before my eyes 
already...! The audience giving us a 
standing ovation!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it as well! Opera 
O-san's 'Melodia' shines with a brilliance 
all its own!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please come by all means, Trainer! I 
promise to make your heart tremble with 
excitement!
And on the day of the performance—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Swirling winds~~♪ Raging thunder~~♪ —Ah, 
just like a storm!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yet on bent knee I shall not fall~~♪ 
Forth I ride to my people's call~~♪"

Just as Sounds of Earth had predicted, the 
performance was magnificent. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I came,♪ I saw,♪ I conquered!♪ Because 
none other than I am here~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Fortissimo right here! Dum, dadum! Dum—)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on a sec~~♪ Is it really 
okay to leave it like this~~♪"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Simply standing upon the stage~~♪ Is not 
enough to convey the Overlord~~♪"

T.M. Opera O strides through the stands 
while singing. This wasn't in the 
rehearsal...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: M-Mamma mia...! Such disrupted armonia...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: How completely ottimo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"This, too, is a soul-stirring impromptu! 
I won't let myself be outdone!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Let us sing together~~♪ Lend me your 
chorus, amica~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Backing vocals, umm... "E-even if you 
ask me to sing along~♪"...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit~~♪ Come on, all of you, 
my lovely divas~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wah! "May I sing along too~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"To the upbeat rhythm~~♪ Can't help but 
hum alooong~~~~♪"
choice_data_list:
(Amazing...! She's drawing everyone in 
with the power of music!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Impressive, Earth-kun...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Then let us all~~♪ sing together~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Sing along to my music~~♪" ——Come on, 
now!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ♪ Toge~ther wi~th the Conque~ror~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo! Grazie! You are the finest 
co-stars!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Beni-ss-simo! The curtain has closed to 
immense applause!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! With me in the leading role, 
it's only natural! And so—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your impromptu piece was truly 
exhilarating!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling is mutual, Sovrana! Your 
improvisation set me ablaze."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we share the stage 
again next time? What production would you 
prefer?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How about letting the audience... the 
Trainer decide that?
choice_data_list:
I wanna watch a mystery with a fast-paced 
plot.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That looks like a program that requires a 
lot of stamina. In that case—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Shall we sprint all the way 
toward that beautiful sunset?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! This is the true music of youth!

"Sounds of Earth and the others worked on 
building up their physical strength for 
their next piece."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mystery...! To express this battle of wits 
through music—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha! Can you decipher this cipher?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't ring a bell at all! But our 
Melodia will definitely play the answer 
for us!

To experience the thrill of mystery 
firsthand, Sounds of Earth and the others 
took on an escape room.
